sourceDecision: CSharp EmitNameExpression loads RuntimeReference for local names. SLG emitNamedPlaceRead already loads referenced formal parameters, but its immutable local branch freezes the initializer pointer with the reference type. Downstream value consumers expect the referenced aggregate. Extend shared named-read materialization and its existing classification for immutable local reference bindings; preserve pointer forwarding, direct reference-expression admission and async-frame paths.
